name: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
summary: TwinD, trained on reconstruction and blob twins derived from real frames, detects both blending and entire-face-synthesis deepfakes, improving AUROC over prior detectors.
